name: Kanban Board — Vercel
description: Refined dark monochrome project kanban board with hairline borders, a subtle radial glow, a single teal status accent, and count pills. Draggable task cards move between Backlog, In Progress, Review, and Done via the HTML5 Drag and Drop API, count badges update live, and an add-card affordance creates new tasks per column. Generous spacing and a premium dev-tool aesthetic.
